text:
alex: Heads-up from the rerank/emb bench run — I see a mid-load straggler tail and suspect our slot packing + kernel affinity logic is the culprit. Posting raw snapshot and proposal.

alex: Benchmark context: 8k non-chat rerank calls, avg_docs=28, bursty ingress pattern (tail bursts every 30s).

alex: Perf excerpt (steady window):
```
kernel=attn_prefetch_v1
p50=10ms p90=38ms p99=185ms
kv_retention=0.64
avg_batch_reqs=6.8
slot_packing=naive_fill
kernel_affinity_weight=0.2
straggler_ratio=0.09
```

priya: p99 185ms + straggler_ratio 9% is higher than acceptable. Any sign of KV eviction spikes when bursts happen?

alex: Yes. Tracing shows a pattern: naive_fill mixes short + long seq lengths. When a longer request arrives, kernel_affinity flips and we evict cache lines for previous slots -> kv_retention drops briefly. Also slot_packing causes some small batches that increase overhead.

marc: Idea: "slot packing with straggler-smoothing" — create primary compact slots by seq_len buckets, but allow a small overflow buffer (prefill debt) that preferentially drains short requests first to avoid starvation. Also raise kernel_affinity_weight so we bias kernel stability over raw token fill.

jenna: For rerank endpoints (non-chat) we prioritize throughput per-second and steady latency. Smoothing sounds promising. Can we simulate impact on KV retention and flips?

alex: Ran a focused sim (bench/slot_pack_sim.py) comparing policies. Short summary below.

```
baseline=naive_fill -> p90=38ms p99=185ms kv_retention=0.64 kernel_flips/min=0.21
candidate=slot_pack+straggler_smooth -> p90=26ms p99=110ms kv_retention=0.81 kernel_flips/min=0.05
notes: avg_reqs_per_batch -4% (smaller batches) but homogeneous seq_len up 42%
```

priya: That's a solid p99 drop. What are the exact knobs for candidate? Need to know guardrails to avoid latency regressions for long queries.

alex: Candidate params in sim: slot_token_target=1400, overflow_buffer_capacity=3_reqs, overflow_drain_policy=shortest_first, kernel_affinity_weight=0.8, max_wait_ms=120. Long requests get their own 'long' slot and bypass overflow if waiting > max_wait_ms.

marc: Operationally we should track these additional metrics: kernel_affinity_switches, kv_retention_5s, overflow_drain_rate, and prefilling_backlog. Also add a guard: if avg_p99 increases >20% or kv_eviction/sec >2x, rollback.

jenna: Dashboards: add a stacked timeline with p50/p90/p99, overlay kernel_affinity_switches, and a per-seqlen kv_retention heatmap. Also add a small panel showing overflow_buffer occupancy.

alex: I'll implement metrics and a lightweight canary. Proposed rollout: enable slot_pack+straggler_smooth in staging, then 3% prod -> 15% -> 50% -> 100%, with 1h observation windows.

priya: Cost check: tighter packing may reduce KV misses but increase kernel inefficiency per-token. Please run cost_sim (cycles/GPU-second) and throughput sim. Target total cost delta < 4% or justify with latency improvement.

alex: Will run cost sim overnight and attach numbers. Quick note: perf-bot flagged a micro-regression on attn_prefetch_v1 in unrelated patch last week; we should keep an eye on kernel-specific regressions once canary runs.

perf-bot: Alert: attn_prefetch_v1 had a +3% median perf variance in last 48h (internal perf CI). Recommend kernel_gate=false for canary until we validate.

marc: Good call. For canary gate: only enable policy when kernel-flip_rate < 0.08/min and perf-bot variance <1% for the kernel used. We can also restrict initial canary to smaller GPU pool to limit blast radius.

infra-bot: Canary job queued: slot_pack_straggler_smooth -> staging (build 2026.03.18-2350). Logs: /logs/bench/1719005555-slotpack-canary.

jenna: Thanks. Once sim & cost results posted, I'll create the dashboard PR and add alarms.

priya: I'll own the cost sim and post results by tomorrow AM. If >4% cost delta, we need a trade-off doc.

alex: Action items: implement metrics (kernel_affinity_switches, overflow_drain_rate, kv_retention_5s), run cost sim, start canary in staging, add overflow buffer config to runtime flags.

alex: Linking sim script: bench/slot_pack_sim.py (note: seq_len bucketing logic at lines ~210-260). Comments welcome.

infra-bot: Canary started: slot_pack_straggler_smooth on rerank-family -> staging (build 2026.03.18-2350).
